# Independent Hodgkin–Huxley reference

`independent-hh.json` is generated by `reference_models.py` with NumPy and SciPy, independently of the JavaScript implementation. Run from the repository root with `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python tests/fixtures/neuro/reference_models.py`. DOP853 integrates the original squid equations at relative tolerance1e-10, absolute tolerance1e-11, maximal step0.1ms, and detects upward0mV crossings. The JSON records six constant-current/temperature cases, all spike times, late-period rates and final states. It is fixed reference evidence; the regular JavaScript test does not require Python.

`independent-burst.json` is generated by `reference_burst.py`, which independently writes the explicit Morris–Lecar/Ca-feedback equations and integrates 20,000 ms with SciPy DOP853 (relative tolerance 1e-10, absolute tolerance 1e-11, maximum step 0.5 ms). Parameters are embedded in the generator, with no import from the JavaScript model. Upward 0 mV events supply the reference spike times. Regenerate from the repository root with `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python tests/fixtures/neuro/reference_burst.py`.
